title: Audit event
description: One line of the append-only audit trace: one tool call by one role for one invoice, allowed or denied. Inputs and outputs are stored as SHA-256 hashes, never as text, so the trace holds no invoice content or bank detail.

invoice_id.description: The invoice the call belongs to. 'unscoped' when the call is not tied to one invoice.

tool.description: The tool id as written in policy/tool-policy.yaml, for example mcp__erp__run_query.

input_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the tool input (sorted keys, no spaces).

output_hash.description: SHA-256 of the tool output. Null when the call was denied or the output is not recorded.

note.description: The reason for a denial, or ok.
